facts.fact: Seine 在房车里用推剪给 Nate 剃头：把他剩下的头发抓起一绺、齐根剃断。
facts.anchor: Seine said down to the kid, and pulled up a hank of what was left of his hair and sliced it off neatly at the base

facts.fact: Seine 向 Nate 交代此行目的：是为了 Heavy Runner 家的孩子，而 Nate 是第四个。
facts.anchor: it’s the Heavy Runner kid. You’re the fourth.

facts.fact: Mooch 出借她的 RV 附三个条件：一不许抽烟（嫌头发沾味），二她太老不能开车（她四十三岁），三要顺路去 Minnesota 替她取一样重要的东西。
facts.anchor: Mooch’s shrugging terms for the use of her precious RV were, first, no smoking, because she didn’t like her hair to smell like that, second, she was too old to drive—how was forty-three too old?—and, third, they make a stop in Minnesota to pick something up for her.

facts.fact: RV 车尾封着一辆头朝下扎进车里的 dirt bike，是给 Mooch 最小儿子 Conrad 做的纪念：他死在 Minnesota，想当特技演员，死前正和一个 Leech Lake 小孩录视频，要证明自己敢以六十的时速冲坡道起跳飞天。
facts.anchor: Seine got it, yeah: it was a memorial for Mooch’s youngest son, who’d died out in Minnesota trying to make it as a stuntman. He wasn’t on any movie set when he died, and it wasn’t for a cheering crowd either. It was just him and some Leech Lake kid recording with a Nokia, trying to get something Conrad could use to prove that he had the nerve to hit a ramp at sixty and launch up into the sky.

facts.fact: 他们的司机 Christian 是 Seine 侄女的独子，和 Mooch 从 IGA 采购回来。
facts.anchor: before Mooch and Christian, their driver—Seine’s niece’s only son—got back from the IGA.

facts.fact: Nate 自一月起就任由全体医护人员把他当“可摆布的假人”（长期住院）。
facts.anchor: posable dummy that he’d been for all medical staff since January

facts.fact: Seine 说出寄宿学校的地点：宾夕法尼亚州 Carlisle。
facts.anchor: “Carlisle, Pennsylvania,” Seine intoned, all the blood rushing to her face.

facts.fact: Nate 终于低声说出：你不能确定把这个孩子带回来，Sebby 就也会回来。
facts.anchor: “You can’t know bringing this kid back’ll bring Sebby back too,” Nate finally said, hardly loud enough to make it past his lips.
